items.exampleEn: The students seemed unenthusiastic about the extra homework.
items.exampleZh: 學生們對額外的作業顯得興趣缺缺。

items.exampleEn: The shop owner was a real scrooge and never gave his workers a day off.
items.exampleZh: 那個店老闆是個不折不扣的吝嗇鬼，從不讓員工放假。

items.exampleEn: The complicated map bewildered the tourists.
items.exampleZh: 那張複雜的地圖把遊客弄糊塗了。

items.exampleEn: Our quarrelsome parrot shouts at every visitor.
items.exampleZh: 我們家那隻愛吵架的鸚鵡會對每位訪客大叫。

items.exampleEn: Her mother reproved her for coming home late.
items.exampleZh: 她媽媽責備她太晚回家。

items.exampleEn: He crossly closed the door behind him.
items.exampleZh: 他氣沖沖地把身後的門關上。

items.exampleEn: The small company performed respectably during a difficult year.
items.exampleZh: 那家小公司在艱困的一年裡表現得還算不錯。

items.sentenceEn: "Stop making that noise!" she said crossly.
items.sentenceZh: 「別再製造那種噪音了！」她生氣地說。

items.audioEn: My team finished respectably in fifth place, even though two players were sick.
items.audioZh: 雖然有兩名球員生病，我們隊還是拿到了還不錯的第五名。
items.questionZh: 說話者的隊伍得了第幾名？

items.sentenceEn: Many fans were unenthusiastic about the new team uniform.
items.sentenceZh: 許多球迷對新的球隊制服不太熱衷。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher gently reproved him for talking during the test.
items.sentenceZh: 老師溫和地責備他考試時說話。

items.stemEn: The ____ brothers argue about everything, even what to watch on TV.
items.stemZh: 那對愛吵架的兄弟什麼都能吵，連看什麼電視都要吵。

items.stemEn: The sudden change of plans ____ everyone, and nobody knew where to go.
items.stemZh: 計畫突然改變，把大家都弄糊塗了，沒人知道該去哪裡。

items.passageEn: Every December, our office holds a small gift exchange. This year, my colleague Dave was unenthusiastic at first and joked that he was a scrooge who hated spending money. The rules bewildered some new workers, because every gift had to cost less than ten dollars and be useful at work. Two quarrelsome colleagues argued about who should open the first gift, and our manager crossly told them to stop. In the end, Dave gave the best gift: a cup with everyone's names on it.
items.passageZh: 每年十二月，我們辦公室都會舉辦小型交換禮物。今年，我的同事 Dave 一開始興趣缺缺，還開玩笑說自己是個討厭花錢的吝嗇鬼。規則把一些新同事弄糊塗了，因為每份禮物都要低於十美元，而且要在工作上用得到。兩位愛吵架的同事為了誰先拆第一份禮物爭執起來，經理生氣地叫他們停下。最後，Dave 送了最棒的禮物：一個印著大家名字的杯子。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼有些新同事被規則弄糊塗了？

items.promptZh: 別那麼小氣，這只是一點點捐款而已。
referenceEn: Don't be such a scrooge; it's only a small donation.
Don't be a scrooge; it is just a small donation.
rubricZh: 要用 scrooge（例如 such a scrooge、a scrooge）
首字大寫寫成 Scrooge 也正確

items.promptZh: 他雖然沒什麼錢，卻總是穿得很體面。
referenceEn: He doesn't have much money, but he always dresses respectably.
Although he has little money, he is always respectably dressed.
rubricZh: respectably 修飾動詞或分詞（例如 dresses respectably、is respectably dressed 等）
「雖然…卻」可寫，例如 but、although 等；always 位置不扣分
